jobs.name: th-portrait-riceField
jobs.prompt:
Place the person from this photograph into a new scene: a ripe golden rice paddy at harvest time — glowing yellow rice heads, low warm sun, soft haze over distant fields. Cut the person out cleanly with hair strands and edges intact and re-light them to match the new scene's light direction, colour and softness, with correct contact shadows and reflections; keep the camera angle, framing and crop of the original. POSE LOCK: the exact same pose as the photograph — the same raised arm with the hand in her hair, the same head angle, the same smile, the same loose hair over the shoulders, the same white sleeveless top, denim shorts and white sneakers; add nothing to her (no sunglasses, no hat, no jewellery, no bag); she stands in the same spot of the frame at the same size.

IDENTITY LOCK: this is the same photograph of the same person — keep the face, expression, skin tone, hair, body, pose, clothing and framing exactly as they are; do not beautify, slim, age or restyle anyone.
REALISM: a photograph, not a render — natural skin texture, true lens optics, no plastic smoothing, no painterly or CGI look.
AVOID: a different person or face, a changed pose or outfit, added text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, extra limbs, warped hands, duplicated people, a changed crop. NO STUDIO GEAR IN THE FRAME: no softboxes, light stands, umbrellas, reflectors, lamps, C-stands, backdrop stands or any photographic equipment may be drawn into the picture — light itself is welcome, the equipment that makes it never is.
TASK GUARD: return exactly one finished photograph and nothing else — no text, no captions, no UI, no watermark; keep the original aspect ratio and resolution feel.

jobs.name: th-architecture-luxuryVilla
jobs.prompt:
Redesign this building or room in a new architectural style: a luxury modern villa — travertine stone and warm walnut cladding, bronze-framed glass, a cantilevered roof, a manicured lawn with a lit water feature, dusk light. Keep the camera position, the structure's footprint, proportions, floors and the positions of windows and doors; change the materials, finishes, colours, details, lighting and landscaping to match the style. Photoreal architectural photography. STRUCTURE LOCK (strict): the SAME house — the same two storeys, the same footprint and roof form, the same window and door openings in the same places, seen from the same camera position; only its materials, finishes, landscaping and lighting change.

STRUCTURE LOCK: the same building or room from the same camera position — keep its footprint, proportions, floors and the positions of its openings; restyle surfaces, materials, details and surroundings only.
REALISM: a photograph, not a render — natural skin texture, true lens optics, no plastic smoothing, no painterly or CGI look.
AVOID: a different building, a moved camera, people, cars, signs, added text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, warped geometry, extra objects, a changed crop. NO STUDIO GEAR IN THE FRAME: no softboxes, light stands, umbrellas, reflectors, lamps, C-stands, backdrop stands or any photographic equipment may be drawn into the picture — light itself is welcome, the equipment that makes it never is.
TASK GUARD: return exactly one finished photograph and nothing else — no text, no captions, no UI, no watermark; keep the original aspect ratio and resolution feel.
